title: HR Intern
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
Join us in boosting engagement and connection within HR at ING Netherlands! As theInternal Communications, Learning & Engagement (HR4HR) Intern, you will help inform, connect, and inspire our HR community of 200+ colleagues. You’ll support the Business Manager to the HR Director for NL in delivering communication, learning, and engagement initiatives that bring HR professionals together and boost overall engagement.
This internship gives you the opportunity to gain hands‑on experience in internal communications, event organisation, project management, and community building. You’ll contribute to meaningful projects, learn from experienced colleagues, and shape activities that make HR a great place to work.
You will be part of theHR Netherlands (HR NL)community, working closely with:
TheBusiness Manager to the HR Director NL(who you’ll be reporting to)
TheHR Business Partner for HR
Members of theHR Leadership Team (HRLT)
HR colleagues across different teams and expertise areas
The HR NL community is open, collaborative, and people‑focused. We value learning, curiosity, collaboration, and a “let’s make it happen” mindset.
As theInternal Communications, Learning & Engagement (HR4HR)you’ll be responsible for four main areas:
Organise the quarterlyHR Learning Daysfor the HR NL community
Support the end‑to‑endHR Learning Agendaand drive learning initiatives
Bring fresh ideas to strengthen our learning culture and improve the learning experience
Prepare and co‑createmonthly HR Town Halls
Co‑lead the organisation ofOne‑HR Day,our yearly event that brings all HR colleagues together
Contribute to initiatives that support the HR NL Engagement Strategy
Lead the writing, development, and distribution of the monthlyHR NL community newsletter
Strengthen our communications by improvingclarity, engagement, and storytelling
Continuous Improvement
Implement feedback loops to measure the effectiveness of our learning, engagement, and communication activities
Propose improvements that help professionalise and streamline our ways of working across these three pillars
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
The following skills and experience will be needed to succeed in this role:
Getting things done:you deliver high‑quality results
Working independently:you can manage your own tasks and priorities
Taking initiative:you act autonomously and spot opportunities to improve things
Effective communication:clear writing, strong messaging, and adaptable tone
PowerPoint skills:ability to create engaging slides
Project management:you enjoy planning, organising, and coordinating activities
Background in HR or Communications is helpful, but not required
Above all: you’re enthusiastic, action‑oriented, and eager to learn.
This internship is a great opportunity to work in a dynamic HR environment and learn from experienced colleagues at the heart of HR.
You’ll also benefit from:
Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on a 36 hours work week
Hybrid workingto blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Personal growthand challenging work with endless possibilities
Apeople‑focused, informal, and supportive work culture
Opportunities tobuild your HR networkand gain valuable communication, learning, and engagement experience
To apply, you must be enrolled at aDutch university(or EU university for EU passport holders).
Contact the recruiter attached to this advertisement.Ready to apply? Click theApplybutton and upload yourCVandmotivation letter.
About our internships
Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).
Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
